conflicts.permit: If you contact us via our support channel, we will store your message(s) and other information you choose to give us (for example error logs or information related to your mobile device or your store account) for further analysis.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect any personal information about our players, users or our website visitors.
conflicts.situation: A player, user, or website visitor contacts support and provides personal information (such as email, account, or device information).
conflicts.reason: The policy broadly claims never to collect personal information from users, without qualifying that support inquiries are an exception to this blanket statement.
